representation_fit.evidence: Primary representation is a single 12-step / 4-phase runbook workflow (data.js:11-183) exactly matching the brief's consequential-flow shape: cardinality one, high hierarchy (准备/摘除/销毁/收尾), low density (one focused step at a time), and every irreversible step carries structured consequence+recovery metadata (data.js:65-70, 118-123, 133-137, 165-169). Screenshots show a journey map plus current-step execution console, not a generic dashboard.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900): the dominant main column is the current step card '核对变更单与执行窗口 · 步骤 1 / 12' with its three gate checkboxes and the single primary action 完成本步骤 (rendered by renderCurrentStep, app.js:266-288); the journey list is a subordinate left rail. Nothing competes with the walk-the-flow task on the initial screen.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy. Initial screen answers what/where/next within one glance at both viewports: header names the job and change order (下线指挥台 · CHG-20260919-0417 · 生产服务器安全下线, index.html:17-18 + data.js:4-9), breadcrumb '阶段 1 · 准备 / 步骤 1 / 12', H1 step title with stop-condition instruction, and footer states the zero-mistake policy plus '当前进度 0 / 12 步' (app.js:132-134).

navigation_cost.evidence: The primary object (current step) is on screen at load with zero clicks in both screenshots. Completed steps are reachable in one click from the journey rail (selectStep, app.js:508-515); locked future steps are disabled, which enforces the brief's '零失误走完全程' ordering rather than adding navigation burden (pointer comment '禁止跳步' app.js:29, isLocked app.js:91-94).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions happen in place: checkbox toggles use partial DOM update that preserves input focus (app.js:570-573 '局部更新…保持输入焦点'); completing a step advances the pointer within the same single view (completeStep, app.js:419-438); the confirm modal returns focus to its trigger (app.js:474) and traps Tab (app.js:587-597); the journey rail is sticky and always visible (styles.css:157-165); done-step review is read-only in place with 返回当前步骤 (app.js:316).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly four: header, journey rail, one step card, footer (index.html:11-39). Record drawer, confirm modal, toast and undo strip are hidden until needed ([hidden] display:none !important styles.css:39; undo strip renders empty when no active window app.js:180-183; drawer/hidden index.html:44,56). No control exists without a job-aligned purpose (deviation badge, execution log, reset are all load-bearing for the zero-mistake job).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, a11y.focus_order=pass, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks; 3 fails of 7). Source shows real a11y engineering (:focus-visible outline styles.css:53-57, aria-current="step" app.js:161, role="dialog"/aria-modal index.html:44,56, focus trap app.js:587-597, role="alert" app.js:397, role="status" toast index.html:83), but 16px checkboxes (styles.css:260), 11px phase tags (styles.css:181), 11.5px timeline times (styles.css:422) and #9aa8bc locked-step text (styles.css:201) are consistent with the measured target-size/contrast/type failures.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass and both screenshots render cleanly at 1280 and 1440 (identical structure, no collision/truncation). But 3 of 7 receipt checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size — measurement-summary.json), implying styling rework; plus a code defect where any hovered disabled button turns danger-red (styles.css:121 '.btn:disabled:hover { background: var(--danger); }').

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径' is addressed on every path: confirm-gate modal showing consequence + recovery + mandatory acknowledgment before confirm enables (index.html:56-81, app.js:444-458, 576-578); pre-execution consequence/recovery preview on irreversible step cards (irrevPreviewHtml app.js:241-251); timed undo windows with countdown strip and cascade rollback of dependent steps (app.js:180-197, 478-505); warning flags mark irreversible steps in the journey (app.js:156-158; visible on steps 4/8/9/11 in screenshots); completion certificate includes an irreversible-action audit table with recovery paths (app.js:327-359).

Copy drift between screenshots and source: screenshots render '门槛校验 / 门槛未过不放行 / 完成所有门槛校验后…' while the provided source renders '门禁校验 / 门禁未过不放行' (index.html:37, data.js:9, app.js:255-256, 273) — cosmetic wording only, no functional impact
scores.overall_note: The package is a faithful representation of the brief's consequential-flow job: a single 12-step, 4-phase server-decommission runbook whose initial screen at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 puts the current step (with gate checks and one primary action) in the dominant position, requires zero navigation to reach the primary object, and preserves context through in-place, focus-preserving updates and a persistent journey rail. The brief's acceptance seed — irreversible steps have confirmation/recovery paths — is covered redundantly (confirm-gate modal with acknowledgment, pre-execution consequence/recovery preview, timed undo windows with cascade rollback, and an audit certificate), and the step-locking that limits navigation is policy-aligned with the zero-mistake success criterion. The clear weak spot is measured accessibility: contrast, target size and projected type size all fail in the sanitized receipt despite deliberate a11y structure (focus trap, aria-current, roles, focus-visible), and a minor CSS defect makes hovered disabled buttons render red; no layout defects are visible and the three layout/text checks pass. Per the receipt's own note, the seven checks do not measure task time, retrieval accuracy, or human preference, and time_to_understand here is a model-judged proxy, not a human judgment.
